## Positioning

This is an independent executable audit of HOPE v1, with bounded diagnostics
and a proposed corrected reference design. It is not author code and it does
not claim an exact reproduction of the paper's headline experiments.

## How the site and code stay aligned

The long-form Quarto pages are the public technical articles. Each page links
to focused tests and CSV or JSON evidence in the immutable `v1.0.0` release.
The repository's [artifact checksum index](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/blob/v1.0.0/artifacts/SHA256SUMS)
authenticates the result files, and figures used by the articles are stored
with the site.

The public version identifiers agree across the release tag, Python package,
citations, website, and report: the current release is `v1.0.0`. One complete
test invocation runs 252 tests, and the checksum target authenticates 80
CSV/JSON result files plus 15 editorial PNGs.

## How to read a conclusion

Each substantive check identifies the paper location, isolates the claim being
tested, assigns an evidence label, shows the derivation or finite witness, and
links to the executable check and authenticated result. The six labels keep
paper claims, verified facts, counterexamples, independent inferences,
proposed repairs, and open questions distinct.
